spec.description: KPI snapshot for the selected scope. Degraded if queue >10, failures within the last 10 minutes among the latest 100 results, a running execution >30 min (TeamCity/Jenkins) or >60 min (Octopus), or an unexpectedly offline agent/worker; TeamCity/Jenkins also require at least one available agent. Agents are server-wide, not necessarily idle or compatible with the pipeline. Zero external Octopus workers is allowed because a built-in worker may be used. API errors, permission errors, timeouts or incomplete inventories mean No data, not a confirmed outage. No runs does not prove that a pipeline can execute. The Grafana time range does not filter REST history. This combines independently filtered components; it does not track a single release across TeamCity, Jenkins and Octopus.
